channel.title: BlackFrame AI Studio Blog
channel.description: Daily dispatches, devlogs, and pillar guides from BlackFrame AI Studio.

item.title: Procedural Takeover, Day 17 Codex Locks the HUD to Bind Defaults
item.description: Day 17 enforces bind-default helpers, throttles diagnostics, and cuts legacy loaders so the procedural HUD can stand on its own.

item.title: Crosswind Hardening, Day 16 Codex Stabilizes the Windows Sweep
item.description: Day 16 locks down Windows diagnostics, standardizes patch pipelines, and proves save persistence survives network recovery.

item.title: Instrumented Frontier, Day 15 Codex Verifies the Run
item.description: Day 15 tightens GL validation, visualizes anchor layouts, toggles logging noise, and boots gameplay telemetry with cached builds.

item.title: Diagnostic Cascade, Day 14 Codex Instruments the Signal Spine
item.description: Day 14 layers debug overlays, SynthEngine audio logging, and GPU state capture so Codex can audit every frame.

item.title: Vector Surge, Day 13 Codex Threads Fonts, Network, and Stage FX
item.description: Day 13 unifies procedural sprite parameters, upgrades to vector typography, and keeps network simulation aligned with new stage and space effects.

item.title: Multiframe Failsafe, Day 12 Codex Locks the Recovery Spine
item.description: Day 12 adds a multi-window failsafe, anchors every overlay, wires telemetry into the HUD, and deepens checkpoint restores.

item.title: Signal Array, Day 11 Codex Orchestrates Multi-Window Control
item.description: Day 11 centralizes multi-window control, unifies telemetry routing, and hardens checkpoints with anchored UI and inventory restores.

item.title: Vulkan Flightpath, Day 10 Codex Crosses the Render Divide
item.description: Day 10 split the renderer into pluggable backends, piped telemetry into CombatSimulator, and synced faction overlays to the same state spine.

item.title: Cloudline Convergence, Day 9 Codex Locks the Run
item.description: Day 9 bound StageManager, hub overlays, and cloud backups so Codex can pivot factions mid-run without losing progress.

item.title: Savepoint Uprising, Day 8 Codex Reinvents the Bootstrap
item.description: Day 8 hardened the SaveSystem, swapped apt-get for apt, and reopened FetchContent so Codex can self-heal its builds.

item.title: Bootstrap Recovery, Day 7 Codex Self-Heal
item.description: Day 7 forced Codex to debug its own bootstrap—fixing the frozen input loop, snapshotting the V0.1 branch, and hard-vendoring GLFW so container agents stay online.

item.title: Proof of Frame, Day 6 Render Validation
item.description: Day 6 cleared the renderer’s include snags, captured the first frame hash, and wired per-frame GPU telemetry straight into LogChannel.

item.title: First Light, Day 5 Render Bring-Up
item.description: Day 5 connected the live window stack, GLAD-generated loader, and RenderSystem so Codex can leave telemetry mode and start drawing real frames on the next sprint.

item.title: Laying the Foundation, Day 4 Engine Heartbeat
item.description: Day 4 locked the engine loop into a steady cadence, wiring Codex-built systems into the init-update-shutdown flow and turning instrumentation into our temporary dashboard.

item.title: Game Takes the Stage, Day 3 Runtime Merge
item.description: Day 3 retired the minimal harness, honored the Phase 4 gameplay scaffold, and routed every launcher through game::Game while the debug windows rendered the live procedural sprite stack.

item.title: The Blueprint Days: Trusting Codex With the Wheel
item.description: Day 2 chronicles the moment we stopped throttling Codex, codified the Scaffold Style Checklist, and watched the first 300-frame build prove the engine scaffold in hours.

item.title: The Birth of Vibe Coding, BlackFrame AI Studio
item.description: We built a working engine from Markdown and tests months before the hype, beginning with the constraint lock, behavioral rulebook, and orchestration guardrails that shaped vibe coding.

item.title: AI Engine Foundations, Modular Stack Overview
item.description: A pillar guide for collaborators, explore the simulation spine, narrative canon, creator co-pilots, and observability layers that power the BlackFrame stack.
